{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Packed Ice''' is a tanky enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a higher amount of health than most enemies before it, but it walks at an average speed. The '''Packed Ice''' has a [[Defense]] of 50%, which was set to 100% during the event. ==Logbook Description== "''Packed Ice is a specialized foot soldier of the Frost Army. During their creation, their core beliefs are embedded within their body, marked by an exposed heart. Their motto is simple: become the best defender, for survival depends on it.''" ==Appearance== The '''Packed Ice''' is a foot soldier made out of ice. It has a large, right arm with two grey chains wrapped around it and a hole in its torso, showcasing a piece of ice held by two blue bars. On its head, it has two white eyes with large, blue brows. ==Strategy== *Mid-game or late-game towers like the [[Turret]], [[Enforcer]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Necromancer]] can be useful against it. *The '''Packed Ice''' has a [[Defense]] of 50%, reducing most forms of damage by 33%. **Towers that bypass [[Defense]], like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Military Base]] or [[Mortar]] can be useful against it because of this. **Similarly, defense dropping towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be used to reduce its [[Defense]]. ***Despite being an ice-themed enemy, the '''Packed Ice''' does not have the [[Freeze Immunity]], meaning freezing towers like the [[Cryomancer]] or [[Freezer]] can also be used. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePackedIce1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpsePackedIce2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Packed Ice''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} PackedIceIconIG.png|'''Packed Ice''' icon in the [[Index]]. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Packed Ice''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
